facts.fact: ARCEP began an inspection operation in Bangui against unregistered Starlink kit users and Wi-Fi providers; the minister says over 3,000 people use Starlink kits illegally against 200 registered with ARCEP, and the sweep is to extend to provincial towns (article dated 2026-08-14, operation said to start 'Wednesday').

note: Enforcement against unregistered use, recorded as none.
